## Description

Trade options when implied volatility differs from a forecast of realized volatility, repeatedly hedging delta in the underlying.

## Where it may fit

Liquid options with reliable realized-volatility forecasts and low hedge friction.

## Vehicles

Volatility-arbitrage hedge funds, market makers and institutional options portfolios.

## Required data

Full option chain, Greeks, implied vols, high-frequency underlying prices, realized-vol estimates, rates/dividends and hedging costs.

## Caveats

Residual gamma/vega, jumps, transaction costs and hedging frequency can overwhelm the signal.
